questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow backgrounds and black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign warns that a divided highway is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Driving with your headlights out of alignment because one side of your car is higher than the other.
Damaging a tire from drifting onto the shoulder.
Hydroplaning, if the shoulder has water on it.
Losing control of the vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: Losing control of the vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the shoulder is lower than the road ahead. If your wheel drifts onto the low shoulder, do not slam the brakes or steer sharply. This can cause you to lose control of your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and prepare drivers for upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns drivers to watch for traffic entering from a side road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Should maintain your vehicle’s speed until you enter the reduced speed zone.
Should begin to reduce your vehicle’s speed.
Should not slow down because traffic will start to back up.
May reduce your speed, if you choose to do so.

questions.correctAnswerText: Should begin to reduce your vehicle’s speed.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers to start slowing down. The new speed limit will be shown on the next speed limit sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Construction zones are dangerous for both drivers and workers. Orange construction signs warn drivers to be careful. This sign alerts drivers that construction workers are on or near the road and they should drive with extra caution.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign warns drivers that a playground is nearby and they should watch for children on or near the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic signal ahead is displaying a red light.
The traffic signal ahead is broken.
The traffic signal ahead is displaying a green light.
There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that there is a traffic signal at the next intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Sharp right turn in the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Sharp right turn in the road ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a sharp right turn is coming ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a bus stop ahead.
There is a stop sign ahead.
There is a caution sign ahead.
You must stop if other cars stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a stop sign ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign warns drivers that a stop sign is ahead so they can prepare to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
Lane reduction; the left lane ends soon.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the right lane will end ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers about construction zones. This sign tells you a flagger is ahead. Follow the flagger's directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign tells you a detour is coming up in 1,000 feet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign means you cannot park in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
Slow down without coming to a complete stop.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
questions.explanation: All eight-sided signs are stop signs. You must come to a complete stop. Look for pedestrians and other traffic before proceeding.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Yield just to the traffic on the right.
Yield just to the traffic on the left.
Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means slow down and let other traffic pass before you enter the intersection or roadway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a four-way intersection is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No traffic is allowed in this lane.
You must merge into this lane.

questions.explanation: A green arrow pointing down over a lane means you can use that lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign tells you a yield sign is coming up. Be ready to slow down and let other traffic pass.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped warning signs with yellow backgrounds alert drivers to hazards. This sign warns that wet roads may be slippery and harder to control.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign means you can turn right or go straight from this lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is for one-way traffic only.
That due to upcoming roadwork, there is a detour to the right.
Slow down because the road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.
There is a crossroad to your right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down because the road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead will curve sharply to the right. You should slow down before you reach the curve, just as you would at an intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
The road ahead turns sharply left, then right.
The road ahead curves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road will turn sharply right and then sharply left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: When a driver extends their left arm downward, they are signaling that they are about to stop. If you are following this driver, adjust your speed accordingly.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Entrances from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.

questions.correctAnswerText: Entrances from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot enter. It warns that the road is one-way and you are approaching from the wrong direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers to wait for a left turn signal before turning left. Only turn when the signal indicates it is safe to do so.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
Specific turning movements are allowed from specific lanes.
Drivers in both lanes are responsible for merging smoothly.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
questions.explanation: This is a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane. Only buses and cars with the required number of passengers (as shown on the sign) are allowed to use this lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow backgrounds and black markings. They tell you about hazards ahead. This sign warns of a steep hill. Be ready to adjust your speed to drive safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Don’t park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash over a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign prohibits right turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
Drive with caution and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must come to a full stop and wait for the road to be clear before you proceed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars in right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes moving in the same direction will soon merge into one lane. Be prepared to merge smoothly with other traffic.
